events.reason: A second helmeted player has entered from the left and is approaching the player beside the goalpost.
The two players overlap closely, with the rear player immediately behind the ball carrier.
Additional helmeted players have joined from the left, forming a visible group around the original player.
The group has moved into the foreground; multiple players cluster shoulder to shoulder and the wider field is revealed.
The football is visibly airborne above and to the left of the foreground group.
A striped official is now clearly visible at the left holding the football while the foreground players remain clustered.
The foreground cluster begins separating, with one large player remaining to the right as others move left.

uncertainties: All 240 frames were inspected as 192x107 contact-sheet tiles; small ball and hand details remain limited outside the listed native views. No claim is made about scoring, intent, or player identities.

events.reason: A hard cut reveals a close view of the motorcycle engine, crouched worker, drain pan, green jug and aerosol can.
The worker sits back with a long metal tool raised and the other hand below the motorcycle.
The tool is held upright away from the engine near the worker's lap, exposing the engine and pan.
The worker bends deeply toward the engine again, with head and torso obscuring the hands near the pan.

uncertainties: All 240 frames were inspected as contact-sheet tiles. The precise mechanical operation and any small removed component are not reliably visible; reasons describe only visible poses and tool placement.

events.reason: The seated player has extended the nearer arm farther across the keyboard and raised her gaze toward the sheet music.

uncertainties: All 240 frames were inspected as contact-sheet tiles. Fine finger movements were treated as repetitions of keyboard playing, not separate semantic events; exact notes and key presses are not resolved.

events.reason: The long inflated yellow balloon points steeply down toward the camera, filling the foreground beside the seated person.
The camera dips away from the balloon to reveal the sofa base, crossed feet, floor and objects below.
The camera has returned to the inflated balloon in front of the seated person, with lower sofa and floor still visible.
The inflated balloon abruptly disappears and thin yellow fragments are visible in front of the seated person, whose hand remains at the mouth.

uncertainties: All 240 frames were inspected as contact-sheet tiles. Camera shake and motion blur limit intermediate detail; frame 208-209 native views show yellow fragments, but the cause of the balloon disappearance is not inferred.
